about_short_description.short_description: Pindrop uses AI-based IVR authentication and anti-fraud solutions to increase efficiency in call centers and stop fraudulent transactions.

product.name: Pindrop® Pulse
product.description: AI-based deepfake detection for voice and video interactions. It identifies synthetic voices and video participants in contact centers and virtual meetings using liveness and anomaly analysis.

product.name: Pindrop® Protect
product.description: A fraud detection solution that evaluates calls in near real time and generates fraud-risk assessments to help organizations identify suspicious activity and protect customer accounts.

product.name: Pindrop® Passport
product.description: A passive, multifactor caller-authentication solution that evaluates voice, device, and behavioral signals to verify customers without requiring additional steps from legitimate callers.

product.name: Fraud Assist
product.description: An AI-assisted investigation service that helps fraud teams analyze phone-fraud cases, prioritize investigative work, and resolve cases more efficiently.

product.name: VeriCall® Technology
product.description: Call-risk assessment technology that evaluates voice and other interaction signals without interrupting the agent or customer experience.
